newsitem.title: USA: CME hog and pork belly futures expected higher.
newsitem.headline: CME hog and pork belly futures expected higher.

text.p: CME hog futures were expected to open 0.100 to 0.200 cent a lb higher while pork bellies were called 0.300 to 1.000 cent higher, livestock analysts said.

The much-lighter-than-expected hog marketings have again forced packers to bid cash hog prices up despite negative balance sheets on slaughter operations. The higher hog prices should encourage further strength in hog futures, sources said.
Lighter hog runs were attributed to farmers being in the fields and apparent holdback of gilts to expand breeding herds, analysts said.
The bullish attitude from producers reflects optimism from the Taiwan pork ban and ensuing outlook for larger pork exports, they said.
